user.title: Add Orvibo Curtain
user.description: Sign in with your Orvibo/HomeMate account.

family.title: Choose your home
family.description: Your account has more than one home. Pick the one with the curtain.

device.title: Choose your curtain
device.description: Pick the curtain motor from your account's devices. Known curtain motors are listed first.

manual.title: Enter device ID
manual.description: Enter your curtain motor's device ID (its 32-character uid).

data_description.device_id: Captured from the HomeMate app, for example via Frida (see the README).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Orvibo Curtain
reauth_confirm.description: The Orvibo cloud rejected the saved password for {email}. Enter your current password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Orvibo cloud.
error.invalid_auth: The Orvibo cloud rejected the email or password.
error.device_list_failed: Could not load your device list. You can still enter the device ID manually.

abort.cannot_connect: Signed in, but the curtain's control connection failed. Try again later.

data_description.invert_position: When enabled, 0% means fully open and 100% means fully closed.
data_description.open_position: The motor position that counts as fully open. Home Assistant's 0-100% is scaled to fit, so with 90% the curtain opens to 90% and shows as 100% open, and 50% on the slider moves it to 45%.
